# LSTM on the validation period (generated by `scripts/run_lstm.py`)

Dataset sha256 `ee5bc65756cd7976...`, git commit `25f367eb86` (working tree dirty: False); torch 2.14.1+cpu; 4 threads, CPU only. Validation targets 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30; the test period was not loaded. Scenario A. Tuning: 12 random trials per horizon (XGBoost used 30; see protocol deviation log) on feature set L1 (stage 2: own tuning of the history+calendar variant; compared with the stage-2 XGBoost log); early stopping on validation, so the numbers are mildly optimistic. Headline = mean prediction of 3 seeds (same convention as XGBoost).

## Horizon 1 h (train samples 19,887; validation samples 4,367)

Tuning: 12 trials in 14.3 min; best trial #0: hidden=64, lr=0.002678, dropout=0.10, weight_decay=1.5e-06.

| feature set | MAE per seed, mean +- sd (MW) | MAE of 3-seed mean prediction | vs best ridge (CI) | vs XGBoost headline (CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| L1_history_calendar | 1,564 +- 38 | 1,485 | +396 (+340 to +473) | +381 (+331 to +440) |

Reference on the same samples: best ridge (ridge_full_abs) 1,089 MW; XGBoost headline (3-seed mean) 1,104 MW. Negative differences mean the LSTM is better (paired MAE, 95% moving-block bootstrap).
